## Aura Cascade Reimagined 0.2.1 NeoForge Beta

Initial NeoForge loader beta for Minecraft 1.21.1 and Java 21, on the existing 0.2.1 gameplay baseline. Requires NeoForge 21.1.252 and Patchouli 1.21.1-93-NEOFORGE; Fabric API and Team Reborn Energy are not required. Back up existing worlds before upgrading.

This beta does not include the canonical 0.2.2 repairs and is not a claim of full feature parity or exhaustive gameplay validation.

Known inherited Fabric 0.2.1 risks, not confirmed as NeoForge defects or claimed repaired: AC-022-001, Breeder accepts juveniles; AC-022-002, duplicate offspring observed (causal explanation still under investigation); and AC-022-003, Binding Ring costs link opens the wrong entry.
